title: stellera chamaejasme subsp. angustifolia
intro: Stellera chamaejasme subsp. angustifolia, commonly known as the Starflower, is a plant species in the Stellera genus. It has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-boosting properties. The therapeutic actions of the Starflower plant include the inhibition of inflammatory processes, the scavenging of free radicals, and the modulation of the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Stellera chamaejasme subsp. angustifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
